summary: You decide how often managed tenants update, and reminder mail is safe to leave on.

new.title: Set how often managed tenants update
new.text: The Job schedule page lets you switch the managed-tenant pull or the publish on or off, set an interval from 5 minutes to a day, and run it now.
new.action: After upgrading, set the interval you want on the Job schedule page; the default is daily.

new.title: Changes publish on commit
new.text: Committing a replicated change on the managing tenant starts a publish, so managed tenants can pick it up within minutes.

fixes.title: Escalation mail is safe to leave on
fixes.text: Escalation mails follow your alert settings, never arrive as a backlog after upgrade, and send at most one reminder per stage to the sponsor department's owners.

fixes.title: One role per workload delegation
fixes.text: A delegation with several workload roles kept only the last one silently. It is now refused with a clear message.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Any whole number is a valid replication ring, ring labels are clearer, and jobs that do not apply show as skipped.
